# Edmundo Kutuzov

> Portfolio of Edmundo Kutuzov, art director based in Maputo, Mozambique — visual identities, art direction, campaign design and digital systems.

Edmundo Kutuzov designs visual identities and communication pieces that capture attention and drive action, blending storytelling, visual hierarchy and typographic craft. Work spans ad campaigns, music videos, clothing collections and brand development for local and international brands.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the studio, featured work, clients and credentials.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Selected campaigns, brand identities and visual systems.
- [Services](/services): Art direction, brand identity, campaign design and digital design, with process and deliverables.
- [About](/about): Experience, skills, tools and selected brands.
- [Contact](/contact): Project briefing form, email, phone and location.
